diff_summary: Reused payload and record guards to reduce CRUD factory complexity while preserving validation order and errors.

verification.command: .venv/bin/python -c 'import ast,pathlib,subprocess; p="backend/app/main.py"; s=pathlib.Path(p).read_text(); names={"_crud_write_payload","_require_crud_record","crud_routes"}; nodes=[n for n in ast.parse(s).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in names]; assert len(nodes)==3; subprocess.run([".venv/bin/ruff","check","--select","C901","--stdin-filename",p,"-"],input=chr(10).join(ast.get_source_segment(s,n) for n in nodes),text=True,check=True)'
